senses.gloss:
Ayah2piṇḍadāna
by Parāśara. Rajapur 711.

Ayanacayanādigaṇita
jy. Oppert I. 5889.

Ayananirṇaya
dh. by Nārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭa, son of Rāmeśvara Bhaṭṭa. Hall p. 178.

Ayanapraśna
jy. Kotah 293.

Ayana_Bhaṭṭa_(?)
--Sandhyāratna. IM. 899.

Ayanamāsapakṣādiphala
jy. Udaipur II. 186, 9.

Ayanavāda
jy. by Rāmadatta. NW. 550.

Ayanāṃśa
jy. Assamese Mss. 7. Trav. Uni. 2506P (with Telugu C.).

Ayanāṃśopapatti
jy. Skt. Col.. Ben. 1905, p. 6 (no. 1427).

Ayācitakālanirṇaya
dh. Ben. 143. SB. 118. Is it a Kālanirṇaya by a. author having ‘Ayācita’ a. his surname ? For ‘Ayācita’ a. a surname, see L. 702. RASB. II. 1462.

Ayācitavrata
dh. Skt. Col.. Ben. 1918-30, p. 33 (no. 270).

Ayyagāru
--Ātmānātmaviveka. PUL. II. p. 38.
--Jīvanmuktiviveka. PUL. II. p. 41.

Ayyaṇa_Vidvat
called Vīṇai Ayyaṇṇa Kavi, because of his having been a. expert on the Vīṇā; son of Veṅkaṭakavi (a. of Rādhāmādhavasaṁvāda an. other Telugu prabandhas); younger brother of poet Narahari (a. of Sudantākalyāṇa an. other Telugu prabandhas); an. pupil of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa (Ayyāvāl).
--Praṇavārthaprakāśa (-sudhodaya). Mysore I. p. 437. III. p. 13.
--Yajñaśāstrārthanirṇaya. Mysore III. p. 14.
--Vyāsatātparyanirṇaya. adv. MD. 15276. Mysore I. p. 453 (wrongly given Aṇṇaya).
Pt.. Vāṇī Vilās Press, Srirangam.
See V. Raghavan, Intro. p.. 64-5, Śāhendravilāsa of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa, Tanjore Sar. Mah. Ser. 54.

Ayyaṇṇācārya
--Viṣṇumāhātmyapaddhati. TD. 21613. But by Ayyaṇṇācārya's unknown son according to Burnell 110b.

Ayyaṇṇācārya
dvaitin; of Bāṇādurai near Kumbhakonam, Tanjore D..; son of Gopālācārya, son of Rāmācārya; pupil of Vasudhendratīrtha.
--Ānandatāratamyasamarthana. Adyar D. X. 631. Extr. p.. 457-8.
--Trimataikyaprakāśikā on the element of agreement in the three schools of Śaṅkara, Rāmānuja an. Madhva. Adyar D. X. 678. Extr. p.. 467-8. [Page366-b] Mysore II. p. 28. PUL. II. p. 44. TCD. 292.

Ayyaṇṇācārya
--Sūtrārthamañjarī. dvai. Mysore I. p. 666.

Ayyapillārya
a. of the Pithapuram inscription of Pṛthvīśvara, dated 1186 A. D. See Epi. Ind. IV. p. 54.

Ayyanbhāṇa
Mack. Mss. Restored Vol. IV. 1838 (p.. 215-18), Granthāvalī, no. 116 (ayyAbhANa). Prativādibhayaṅkar p. 7 (no. 3). C.. below Ayyābhāṇa.

Ayyappārya
--Vidyānuvādāṅgajinasaṁhitā. Moodbidri I. 304. See Jaina Sid. Bhās. XIII. i. p. 33, where a. is given a. Appārya.
See above p. 269b.

Ayyaludīkṣita
Kauṇḍinya gotra; father of Umāpati an. grand-father of Kāśīpati (a. of Mukundānandabhāṇa, ptd. K. M. 16). See also NCC. II. p. 391a an. IV. p. 135a.

Ayyalunātha
alias of Tirumalanātha, son of Bommagaṇṭi Gaṅgādhara.
--Kuhanābhaikṣava Prahasana. MT. 2361. 5224.
See V. Raghavan, ‘Two More Old Farces’, Saṁskṛta Raṅga Annual V. p.. 55-68.

Ayyalumantrin
brother of Decayāmātya, C. 1525 A. D. (a. of Śivamahimnasstavavyākhyā, MD. 11120 etc.).

Ayyalumantrin
brother of Potana or Potarāja, the minister of Recarla Śiṅgaya Mādhava; father of Gauraṇa (a. of Lakṣaṇaḍīpikā, MD. 12952, otherwise called Padārthadīpikā, MD. 1494).

Ayyavāruśāstrin
patronised by Kandanoli Ānandarāya.
--Sabhārañjana, a play (prahasana) in one act. TA. 2392 (a.. [Page367-a.

Ayyākumāratātadeśikamaṅgaḷa
by Pāṭṭrācārya Veṅkaṭācārya on his father Tātācārya (Śrīśaila Śatakratu Caturvedi) of Nāvalpākkam, Tanjore an. Kumbhakonam; Vaiṣṇava guru of the Tanjore Nāyaks.
See V. Raghavan, Proceed. AIOC. X. p.. 181-3.
Pt.. a. Kumbhakonam in Grantha.

Ayyākumāratātadeśikavaibhavaprakāśikā
eulogy on the same person an. by the same a. a. in the above; ibid. p.. 182-3.

Ayyākumāratātadeśikasaṃbhāvanā
eulogy on the same person an. by same a. a. in the above; ibid. p. 183.

Ayyādīkṣita
I a name of Nīlakaṇṭha Dīkṣita a. of Nīlakaṇṭhavijayacampū.

Ayyādīkṣita
II a name of Nīlakaṇṭha Dīkṣita, II, great-grandson of Āccān Dīkṣita II, the elder brother of Ayyā Dīkṣita I or Nīlakaṇṭha Dīkṣita I; was patronised by king Bālarāmavarman of Travancore who gave him the title ‘Prabandhasāgara’; flourished C. 1700 A. D.
--Varṇanāsārasaṅgraha. Adyar II. p. 15a. GD. 1943. 1944. MD. 12115.
See Āccāndīkṣitavaṁśāvalī published by P. P. S. Sastri, śl. 29, an. also V. Raghavan, Adyar Library Bulletin, V. Mss. Notes, p.. 125-8.

Ayyādīkṣita
--Pārvatīstuti. in 103 verses. Taylor I. 233.

Ayyādhvarin
--C. on Anuṣṭhānapaddhati of Kṛṣṇānanda Sarasvatī. TD. 11816.

Ayyādhvarin
styled Ghaṭikāśatakavi; descendant of Ratnakheṭa Śrīnivāsa Dīkṣita an. Rājacūḍāmaṇi Dīkṣita; father of [Page367-b] Mṛtyuñjaya (a. of Pradyumnottaracarita, TD. 3695).

Ayyābhāṇa
a name of the Śṛṅgāratilaka Bhāṇa of Rāmabhadra Dīkṣita. See below, Śṛṅgāratilaka.

Ayyāvāl
Reverential mode of reference to (Śrīdhara) Veṅkaṭeśa (a. of Ākhyāṣaṣṭi, Kulīreśāṣṭaka etc.).

Ayyāvāḷstotrāṇi
Kāmakoṭi 1/20. A collection of the stotras of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa alias Ayyāvāl. See under Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa.

Ayyāveṅkaṭācārya
(also known a. Kirīṭi Veṅkaṭācārya; Veṅkaṭācārya III), son of Aṇṇayācārya II, son of Śrīnivāsa Tātārya; of the Tirumala Bukkapaṭṭaṇam family. See MT. 4264 (b), Gajasūtravādārtha; for his other works see under Veṇkaṭācārya III.
See also J. of the Andhra His. Res. Soc. XIII. i. p.. 17-18.

Ayyāvaiyya
a courtier of Serfoji II of Tanjore, a. Kāverippūmpaṭṭinam; patronised Sūryanārāyaṇa Dīkṣita (a. of Pāṣaṇḍamaṇḍana, TD. 4245).

Ayyāśāstrin
son of Veṅkaṭārya of Aṣṭagotrafamily of Viṭṭhalapura on the banks of the Tāmrā.
--Saptasvarasindhu, written in 1750 A. D. TCD. 33. Triv. Cur. IV. 2.

Ayyāsvāmin
--Karṇāmṛta. Cabaton I. 240 (II).

Āyajñānatilaka
Jain. jy. Pkt. by Bhaṭṭa Vosari, pupil of Dāmanandi. Arrah II. 87. BORI. 470 of 1884-86. 1137 of 1884-87. 1138 of 1884-7 (all with C.). Pannalal Bombay 147. Peters. III. 400 (with C.).
--C. in Skt. by a. Arrah II. 87. Jainagranthāvalī p. 346. Pannalal Bombay 147. Peters. III. 400.

Āyajñānasadbhāva
jy. Jainagranthāvalī p. 346.
--C. Vṛtti. Ibid. p. 346. C.. next.

Āyajñānasadbhāvaprakaraṇa
Dig. Jain. jy. (in 20 sections, containing 196 āryās). by Malliṣeṇa. Pannalal Bombay 148. See also Jaina Sid. Bhās., Vol. IV. 3. p. 187. XIV. 2. p.. 50 ff.

Āyatattva
or AyatattvAdhikAra śilpa. ascribed to Viśvakarman. B. IV. 276. Bühler 550. IO. 6469. 6470 (with Guj. gloss). Mandlik Sup. 189 (v.). See also ABORI. XXIII. p. 15; also P. K. Acharya, Dict. of Hindu Arch. p. 756.

Āyanatattva
jy. by Duṇḍhirāja, son of Vināyaka. RASB. X. i. 6831.

Āyaprakaraṇa
jy. Hpr. II. 20.

Āyapraśna
jy. Bomb. Uni. 508. IM. 1130. 1317. 1318. 9141. Lz. 1084. 1085. Peters. IV. 33. Skt. Col.. Ben. 1903. p. 10 [Page150-a. (no. 1062). 1913-14. p. 14 (no. 2351). Udaipur II. 188. 20.
--by Vighnarāja. BORI. 873 of 1886-92. Mithilā.

Āyapraśna
jy. Jainagranthāvalī p. 346.

Āyama
(MD. 12951), Ayalu (TA. 2585 C.). See Ayyalu Mantrin, NCC. I. p. 271b.

Āyaṃbīlanīsajhāya_(?)
Jain. Chani 2496.

Āyariyauvajjhāe
Jain. Pkt. BORI. D. XVII. iii. p. 428 (43). Filliozat II. 19 (with C. in Skt.. See also above p. 39a, Ācāryādikṣāmaṇaka.

Āyavibhatti
Jain. one of the 32 works enumerated a. belonging to Kāliya-sūtra class; now extinct. Kapadia, Canonical Lit. of the Jainas, p.. 26, 104.

Āyavisohī
Jain. On repentence an. other forms of expiatory purification. One of the 24 works mentioned in Nandī a. belonging to the class Ukkāliya-sūtra. Kapadia, Canonical Lit. of the Jainas, p.. 26, 103.

Āyājibhaṭṭa
father of Haribhāskara (Padyāmṛtataraṅgiṇī, Śuddhiprakāśa (A.D. 1695; IO. 1745) etc. See above Āpāji Bhaṭṭa.

Āyādilakṣaṇa
śilpa. Burnell 62b. TD. 15422.
--from Agastyaśilpa. MD. 13046. 13047 (inc.).
--from Viśvakarmaśilpa. Adyar II. p. 47a (with Tamil gloss). TD. 15451.
See also ABORI. XXIII. p. 15 an. P. K. Acharya, Dict. of Hindu Arch., p. 756.

Āyāradaśā
See Ācāradaśā, Kalpasūtra an. Daśāśrutaskandha.

Āyārappakappa
Jain. See above p. 6a, Ācāraprakalpa.

Āyārāṅga
Jain. See above p. 30a, Ācārāṅga. [Page150-b]

Āyāsivrata
Rice 324 (with C.).
